arxiv-2206-02964.title: Search for extended Lyman- α \alpha emission around 9k quasars at z=2–3 2022 Search for extended Lyman- α \alpha emission around 9k quasars at z=2–3 – 15
arxiv-2206-02964.creator: Rhythm Shimakawa
arxiv-2206-02964.description: Abstract Enormous Ly α \alpha nebulae (ELANe) around quasars have provided unique insights into the formation of massive galaxies and their associations with super-massive black holes since their discovery. However, their detection remains highly limited. This paper introduces a systematic search for extended Ly α \alpha emission around 8683 quasars at z = z= 2.34–3.

arxiv-2308-00002.title: An Overview Of Temporal Commonsense Reasoning and Acquisition
arxiv-2308-00002.creator: Georg Wenzel, Adam Jatowt
arxiv-2308-00002.description: Abstract Temporal commonsense reasoning refers to the ability to understand the typical temporal context of phrases, actions, and events, and use it to reason over problems requiring such knowledge. This trait is essential in temporal natural language processing tasks, with possible applications such as timeline summarization, temporal question answering, and temporal natural language inference.

arxiv-2406-16660.title: Dedicated beam position monitor pair for model-independent lattice characterization at NSLS-II
arxiv-2406-16660.creator: Yongjun Li, Kiman Ha, Danny Padrazo, Bernard Kosciuk, Belkacem Bacha, Michael Seegitz, Robert Rainer, Joseph Mead, Xi Yang, Yuke Tian, Robert Todd, Victor Smaluk, Weixing Cheng
arxiv-2406-16660.description: Abstract This paper reports recent lattice characterization results obtained at the National Synchrotron Light Source II (NSLS-II) storage ring, conducted without reliance on a lattice model. A pair of beam position monitors (BPMs) with bunch-by-bunch (B × \times B) resolution, were recently installed in a section of the storage ring free of magnetic fields.

arxiv-2502-11264.title: Strategic Wealth Accumulation Under Transformative AI Expectations
arxiv-2502-11264.creator: Caleb Maresca
arxiv-2502-11264.description: Abstract This paper analyzes how expectations of Transformative AI (TAI) affect current economic behavior by introducing a novel mechanism where automation redirects labor income from workers to those controlling AI systems, with the share of automated labor controlled by each household depending on their wealth at the time of invention.

arxiv-2504-05937.title: On the Hamilton-Jacobi approach to inflation beyond slow roll
arxiv-2504-05937.creator: and David Wands
arxiv-2504-05937.description: Abstract The Hamilton-Jacobi approach is a powerful tool to describe super-Hubble dynamics during cosmological inflation in a non-linear way. A key assumption of this framework is to neglect anisotropic perturbations on large scales. We show that neglecting the anisotropic sector in the momentum constraint corresponds to discarding the non-adiabatic mode of scalar-field perturbations at large scales.

arxiv-2507-12354.title: Exact Turán number of the Fano plane in the ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -norm
arxiv-2507-12354.creator: Jianfeng Hou, Xizhi Liu, Yixiao Zhang
arxiv-2507-12354.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jianfeng Hou, Xizhi Liu, Yixiao Zhang. A classical object in hypergraph Turán theory is the Fano plane 𝔽 \mathbb{F} , the unique linear 3 3 -graph on seven vertices with seven edges. The Turán density and exact Turán number of 𝔽 \mathbb{F} , first proposed as a problem by Sós [ Sós76 ] in the 1970s, were determined through a sequence of works by De Caen–Füredi [ DCF00 ] , Füredi–Simonovits [ FS05 ] , Keevash–Sudakov [ KS05 ] , and Bellmann–Reiher [ BR19

arxiv-2510-00072.title: Geo-R1: Unlocking VLM Geospatial Reasoning with Cross-View Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2510-00072.creator: Chenhui Xu, Fuxun Yu, Michael J. Bianco, Jacob Kovarskiy, Raphael Tang, Qi Zhang, Zirui Xu, Will LeVine, Brandon Dubbs, Heming Liao, Cassandra Burgess, Suvam Bag, Jay Patravali, Rupanjali Kukal, Mikael Figueroa, Rishi Madhok, Nikolaos Karianakis, Jinjun Xiong
arxiv-2510-00072.description: Abstract We introduce Geo-R1, a reasoning-centric post-training framework that unlocks geospatial reasoning in vision-language models by combining thinking scaffolding and elevating. In the scaffolding stage, Geo-R1 instills a “geospatial thinking paradigm” via supervised fine-tuning on synthetic chain-of-thought exemplars, enabling models to connect visual cues with geographic priors without costly human reasoning annotations.

pmc-12495658.title: Causal relationship between gut microbiota and pneumonia: a Mendelian randomization and retrospective case–control study
pmc-12495658.creator: Pengfei Huang, Yanqi Liu, Nana Li, Qianqian Zhang, Yinghao Luo, Yuxin Zhang, Yuxin Zhou, Wenjing Mu, Mengyao Yuan, Yuhan Liu, Yu Xin, Hongxu Li, Yahui Peng, Xibo Wang, Mingyan Zhao, Kaijiang Yu, Changsong Wang
pmc-12495658.description: BackgroundThe relationship between microbiota and the gut-lung axis has been extensively studied in both experimental and epidemiological contexts. However, it is still unclear whether the gut microbiome plays a causal role in the development of pneumonia.MethodsOur study initially identified the genetic instruments in the gut microbiota GWAS across phylum, class, order, family, and genus levels.

pmc-12528792.title: Assessment of phytotoxicity in soil-like material recovered from landfill mining of legacy waste in open dumpsites
pmc-12528792.creator: Gurusamy Saravanan, Alayna Mariya, Srikrishnaperumal Thangam Ramesh
pmc-12528792.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Biomining, or landfill mining, involves the excavation, processing and engineered disposal of legacy waste from unscientifically created landfills/dumpsites to reclaim valuable land and facilitates to recover resources. However, unrestricted reuse of recovered materials may cause adverse environmental impacts. Soil-Like Material (SLM) constitutes the major fraction of the biomined residues; hence, to achieve the major objective of Biomining, the reusability of SLM must be assessed.

pmc-12577363.title: Extrudability, printability, and strain rate sensitivity metrics of lightweight thermoplastic polyimide (PI) in material extrusion (MEX) additive manufacturing
pmc-12577363.creator: Nectarios Vidakis, Nikolaos Michailidis, Nikolaos Mountakis, Maria Spyridaki, Apostolos Argyros, Vasileios Stratiotou Efstratiadis, Emmanuel Stratakis, Markos Petousis
pmc-12577363.description: Among the high-performance polymers (HPPs) deployed in material extrusion 3D printing, thermoplastic polyimide (PI or TPI) dominates in terms of chemical stability and thermomechanical performance. Such features, suitable for challenging operational environments, nationalize and defend the remarkably expensive filament market. This study comprehensively explores the physical, thermal, rheological, key mechanical, and strain rate sensitivity metrics of PI.

pmc-12584286.title: Developing and validating an evidence-based health promotion program for reproductive donors reflecting their challenges in the process of donation decision-making: a multi-method study protocol
pmc-12584286.creator: Elnaz Iranifard, Samira Ebrahimzadeh Zagami, Hossein Ebrahimipour, Malihe Amirian, Helen T Allan, Robab Latifnejad Roudsari
pmc-12584286.description: BackgroundThe demand for reproductive donation has increased globally. Donors face various challenges, which make decision-making difficult for them and may impact their health and quality of life. It seems that there is no ongoing, holistic healthcare program for reproductive donors in the fertility clinics.

pmc-12618138.title: Small but mighty: cylindrical transparent cap-assisted cholangioscopic electrohydraulic lithotripsy and stone extraction for the treatment of difficult common bile duct stones
pmc-12618138.creator: Xin Li, Wei-Hui Liu
pmc-12618138.description: we introduced the application of a conical transparent cap to enhance selective biliary cannulation, termed as endoscopic retrograde cholangioscopy 3 4 . Building on this innovation, we fitted a cylindrical cap to the distal end of the cholangioscope, achieving enhanced intraoperative visualization, improved stone fragmentation positioning, and smoother stone extraction ( Video 1 ).

pmc-12646182.title: Factors contributing to uncontrolled hypertension in Ekurhuleni District, South Africa: the community health workers’ perspectives. A qualitative analysis
pmc-12646182.creator: Zaheerah Dawood, Kganetso Sekome
pmc-12646182.description: Background:In South Africa, community health workers (CHWs) provide home-based care and health promotion for patients with chronic conditions like hypertension. However, their views on patients’ poor blood pressure control remain unclear. Understanding CHWs’ perspectives could inform future community-level strategies for improving blood pressure management.

pmc-13688853.title: Whistleblowing and retractions concerning Iran-affiliated medical research: motives and editorial perspectives
pmc-13688853.creator: Seyedeh Kimia Zamani, Amin Talebi Bezmin Abadi
pmc-13688853.description: Research integrity underpins credible scientific research. Whistleblowing on research fraud, including data falsification, fabrication, and plagiarism, is critical for identifying flawed publications. Here, we investigated whistleblowers’ roles in the retraction of Iran-affiliated, medically related publications between 2014 and 2024 and documented whistleblowers’ motives and journal editors’ perspectives.
